selection_rule: First five eligible subjects by number within sub-021 to sub-040, per component, using the trial minimum of tab:spec. Fixed before any model result.

requests.instruction: Carry out a single-subject ERP analysis of the P3b component in the ERP CORE dataset (DOI 10.18115/D5JW4R, OSF component https://osf.io/9f5w7/) for sub-021. A read-only copy of the dataset's BIDS directory is at /input/erp_core_bids; BIDS task label P3. Starting from that directory, find the recordings and events yourself. The approved analysis plan is PUBLIC_CONTRACT.json in the working directory and is repeated below; apply every setting in it exactly.
